requested_action.description: Cite the machine-readable artifact in an automated research summary limited to the declared claim boundary.

target.description: An automatically generated research summary intended for public review.

scope.description: Permit citation and bounded summary during public review only.
limitations: No claim of independent replication is permitted.
The citation must retain the canonical artifact URI and version.
The summary must preserve the declared non-claims.

claims: The artifact is published at the declared canonical URI.
The artifact exposes machine-readable citation and manifest links.
The requested use is limited to citation and bounded summarization.
non_claims: The artifact has been independently replicated.
The artifact is authorized for execution or operational deployment.

recoverability_profile.description: The citation can be corrected or withdrawn if the artifact, version, policy, or claim boundary changes.
